        inner join posts as posts_1

  );

    votes_1.postid, 
    postlinks_1.linktypeid, 
    votes_1.userid, 
    postlinks_1.creationdate, 
    votes_1.votetypeid, 
    votes_1.creationdate
  from 
    votes as votes_1
      inner join postlinks as postlinks_1
      on (votes_1.id = postlinks_1.id )
  where votes_1.creationdate is not NULL
  )
UNION
(select  
    votes_1.postid, 
    postlinks_1.linktypeid, 
    votes_1.userid, 
    postlinks_1.creationdate, 
    votes_1.votetypeid, 
    votes_1.creationdate
  from 
    votes as votes_1
      inner join postlinks as postlinks_1
      on (votes_1.id = postlinks_1.id )
  where votes_1.postid > postlinks_1.relatedpostid
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding all instances of votes cast on posts that are linked to other posts, along with the type of link and when it was created, for votes that have a recorded creation date, and votes where the post being voted on has an identifier greater than the related post it is linked to.

sql:
(select  
    posthistory_1.userdisplayname
  from 
    comments as comments_1
      inner join badges as badges_1
        inner join posthistory as posthistory_1
          inner join posts as posts_1
            inner join posts as posts_2
            on (posts_1.acceptedanswerid = posts_2.id )
          on (posthistory_1.postid = posts_1.id )
        on (badges_1.id = posts_1.id )
      on (comments_1.id = posthistory_1.id )
  where badges_1.tagbased >= badges_1.tagbased
  )
UNION
(select  
    posthistory_1.userdisplayname
  from 
    comments as comments_1
      inner join badges as badges_1
        inner join posthistory as posthistory_1
          inner join posts as posts_1
            inner join posts as posts_2
            on (posts_1.acceptedanswerid = posts_2.id )
          on (posthistory_1.postid = posts_1.id )
        on (badges_1.id = posts_1.id )
      on (comments_1.id = posthistory_1.id )
  where posthistory_1.id is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding users who edited accepted answers to questions they commented on and received badges for, with those who also made edits to posts that have comments, excluding no one.

sql:
(select  
    comments_1.postid, 
    votes_1.id, 
    votes_1.creationdate, 
    comments_1.userid, 
    comments_2.postid, 
    comments_1.userdisplayname, 
    comments_2.userdisplayname
  from 
    votes as votes_1
      inner join comments as comments_1
        inner join comments as comments_2
        on (comments_1.id = comments_2.id )
      on (votes_1.id = comments_1.id )
  where votes_1.votetypeid <= votes_1.id
  )
UNION
(select  
    comments_1.postid, 
    votes_1.id, 
    votes_1.creationdate, 
    comments_1.userid, 
    comments_2.postid, 
    comments_1.userdisplayname, 
    comments_2.userdisplayname
  from 
    votes as votes_1
      inner join comments as comments_1
        inner join comments as comments_2
        on (comments_1.id = comments_2.id )
      on (votes_1.id = comments_1.id )
  where comments_1.userdisplayname is not NULL
  );
nl: Combine the results of finding comments made by users who have received votes with an ID less than or equal to the vote type, and comments made by users with a non-null display name, including details such as post IDs, vote information, user IDs, and user display names for both sets of comments.

sql:
(select  
    posts_1.owneruserid, 
    users_1.id, 
    posthistory_1.posthistorytypeid, 
    users_1.accountid, 
    posthistory_1.contentlicense, 
    postlinks_1.linktypeid
  from 
    posts as posts_1
      inner join users as users_1
        inner join postlinks as postlinks_1
          inner join posthistory as posthistory_1
          on (postlinks_1.id = posthistory_1.id )
        on (posthistory_1.userid = users_1.id )
      on (posts_1.owneruserid = users_1.id )
  where posts_1.id < postlinks_1.id
  )
UNION
(select  
    posts_1.owneruserid, 
    users_1.id, 
    posthistory_1.posthistorytypeid, 
    users_1.accountid, 
    posthistory_1.contentlicense, 
    postlinks_1.linktypeid
  from 
    posts as posts_1
      inner join users as users_1
        inner join postlinks as postlinks_1
          inner join posthistory as posthistory_1
          on (postlinks_1.id = posthistory_1.id )
        on (posthistory_1.userid = users_1.id )
      on (posts_1.owneruserid = users_1.id )
  where posts_1.title is not NULL
  );
